ARC-01.evidence: Lists of workflows, executions, credentials use hand-written TypeORM queries with per-feature indexes (packages/@n8n/db/src/repositories; packages/@n8n/db/src/migrations/migration-index-sync.ts); user data tables are real SQL tables whose columns come from the definition (data-table-ddl.service.ts:80-87) but no index is derived from the definition and there is no search index. Cache service exists (packages/cli/src/services/cache).
ARC-01.alt_note: Data-table definitions drive real typed columns that the database can filter, which is better than a generic key-value scan.

ARC-02.evidence: TypeORM migration framework for Postgres and SQLite; 36 of 59 Postgres migration files define down() (packages/@n8n/db/src/migrations/postgresdb); `n8n db:revert` (packages/cli/src/commands/db/revert.ts); migration tests run against seeded data in CI (packages/cli/test/migration/*.test.ts, .github/workflows/test-db-reusable.yml). Expand-and-contract is review guidance only (.agents/review-rules/db-migrations, .agents/skills/db-migrations), and runtime data-table DDL is a separate path (data-table-ddl.service.ts) not migrated by the same mechanism.
ARC-02.alt_note: Migrations are tested in CI against data on both databases.

ARC-03.evidence: Default is regular mode, one main process (packages/@n8n/config/src/configs/scaling-mode.config.ts). Queue mode adds stateless workers and webhook processes over Redis/Bull (packages/cli/src/scaling/scaling.service.ts); a second main needs the licensed multi-main setup with leader election (packages/cli/src/scaling/multi-main-setup.ee.ts, leader-election-client.ts), so the main stays a singleton by default.

ARC-04.evidence: Executions run asynchronously in-process (regular) or as Bull jobs (scaling.service.ts:357-368 addJob with priority, removeOnFail); no automatic job retry/back-off or dead-letter queue; scheduled triggers run once across mains only through licensed multi-main leader election (multi-main-setup.ee.ts); Redis lock service (redis-lock.service.ts).

ARC-05.rationale: multi_tenant is false in the default (Community) configuration: team projects need a licence (license.ts getTeamProjectLimit defaults to 0).

ARC-06.evidence: Benchmark package and harnesses (packages/@n8n/benchmark, packages/testing/performance, packages/testing/playwright/tests/infrastructure/benchmarks) run nightly (.github/workflows/test-benchmark-nightly.yml cron, test-e2e-performance-reusable.yml cron) and on PRs only when performance tests change (ci-pull-requests.yml:148-152). No documented per-surface limits or budgets found.
ARC-06.alt_note: A performance suite exists and runs on schedule in CI.

ARC-07.evidence: Health and readiness endpoints (/healthz, /healthz/readiness, packages/cli/src/abstract-server.ts:139). Prometheus /metrics is off by default (packages/@n8n/config/src/configs/endpoints.config.ts:8-9 enable=false); no published SLOs or alert rules found (searched docs/, packages/cli/src/metrics).

ARC-08.evidence: Per-node retryOnFail and continueOnFail, HTTP Request timeouts, workflow execution timeout, task runner timeout (packages/@n8n/config/src/configs/runners.config.ts:54-55 taskTimeout 300 s) with Code nodes in a separate runner process; a failing integration fails only its execution. Circuit breakers only in log-streaming destinations (packages/cli/src/modules/log-streaming.ee/log-streaming-destination.service.ts); no fault-injection suite beyond infrastructure chaos specs (packages/testing/playwright/tests/infrastructure/chaos).

ai.evidence: AI Agent node supports an optional fallback model (packages/@n8n/nodes-langchain/nodes/agents/Agent/agents/ToolsAgent/V3/helpers/createAgentSequence.ts, tests in helpers/tests/createAgentSequence.test.ts) plus node retry and timeouts; a provider failure is contained to the node/execution. MAL-01.evidence: Operators create data tables (a new kind of record with typed columns, project-scoped permissions and generic public-API presence) in the UI with no deploy; the product runs the DDL itself (packages/cli/src/modules/data-table/data-table.controller.ts, data-table-ddl.service.ts:80-87, packages/@n8n/api-types/src/dto/data-table/data-table-public.dto.ts). MAL-02.alt_note: Operators add typed fields through the UI and the same definition drives UI and API.

MAL-03.evidence: No declarable relations between data tables and no lifecycle-state definitions; state is coded per feature (workflow active/archived, review states in workflow-reviews.ee). Workflows can implement state machines but nothing declares them.

MAL-04.evidence: Generic data-table rows API for any operator-defined table with no per-table code (packages/cli/src/public-api/v1 data-table handlers; data-table-public.dto.ts).

MAL-05.evidence: Publishing a workflow with a Webhook or Form trigger creates a live HTTP endpoint at runtime with no build (packages/cli/src/webhooks); adding a data-table column changes what the generic rows API accepts immediately. No per-consumer versioning or dry-run.

MAL-06.evidence: Hand-written OpenAPI spec for the public API v1 (packages/cli/src/public-api/v1/openapi.yml, published by .github/workflows/util-publish-api-schema.yml), Zod-validated DTOs with structured errors; internal REST API undocumented; no dry-run.
MAL-06.alt_note: The public surface is fully described in OpenAPI and typed clients can be generated from it.

MAL-07.evidence: Product pages are coded Vue components (packages/frontend/editor-ui/src); no operator page layout data. Form Trigger forms are defined as node parameters and rendered generically, but that is end-user forms, not product layout.
MAL-07.alt_note: Form layouts are data in the workflow definition.

MAL-08.evidence: Data tables get a generic grid (list and inline edit) from their column definitions (frontend features/core/dataTable); forms render from Form Trigger specs; no view-spec format for detail views.

MAL-09.evidence: Design tokens in @n8n/design-system and UI text in @n8n/i18n locale files, engineer-managed; light/dark theme; no operator theme editor or per-instance text overrides found.

MAL-10.evidence: Workflows are the rules engine: operators compose triggers, conditions (IF/Switch/Filter) and actions across every integration and data table in the editor, with manual test runs and pinned data; 'Debug in editor' replays past execution data; JSON definitions are versioned (workflow history). MAL-10.alt_note: Workflows are machine-readable, versioned, simulatable against past executions and AI-authorable with structured validation through MCP validate_workflow/create_workflow_from_code once MCP is on.

MAL-11.evidence: Internal events reach workflows through the n8n Trigger node and error workflows; the event bus (packages/cli/src/eventbus) streams workflow lifecycle and audit events to destinations only with licensed log streaming (modules/log-streaming.ee, 'Requires feat:logStreaming'), which has a circuit breaker; no replay.

MAL-13.evidence: Plugin points are nodes and credential types, in code or declarative routing style (packages/workflow node interfaces; packages/@n8n/node-cli), installable as community packages; no plugin points for layout, theme or text.

MAL-14.evidence: Community nodes run in the main/worker process with full trust after optional scanning (packages/@n8n/scan-community-package, verified community nodes); Code-node code (including AI-written code) runs in a separate task-runner process with memory and time limits but no egress control.

EXP-01.evidence: Kernel primitives are domain-neutral: workflow, node, connection, credential, execution, project, user, data table (packages/workflow, packages/@n8n/db/src/entities); every business domain lives in nodes and workflows above them.

EXP-02.evidence: A new business domain is workflows plus credentials plus data tables with no kernel change; curated templates across domains ship in the assistant knowledge base (packages/@n8n/instance-ai/knowledge-base) and the template gallery (packages/@n8n/config/src/configs/templates.config.ts).

EXP-03.evidence: Installable .n8np packages bundle projects, folders, workflows and credential dependencies with a manifest and requirements, imported through UI, public API and CLI with import gates (packages/cli/src/modules/n8n-packages/spec/manifest.schema.ts, requirements.schema.ts, engine/import-orchestrator.ts).

EXP-04.evidence: No in-product record of unmet intents (failed node searches, unsupported assistant requests) that operators can query; such signals go to the vendor's telemetry (AGENTS.md telemetry catalog) outside the product.

EXP-05.evidence: Suggest-automations proposes common automations from the model's knowledge of the user's team and apps, not from demand data (packages/@n8n/instance-ai/skills/suggest-automations/SKILL.md).

AIR-03.evidence: Instance AI reaches live workflows, executions, credential metadata, data tables, node definitions and docs through schema-aware tools via the adapter (instance-ai.adapter.service.ts; tools/*.tool.ts), always current because they read the database at call time.

AIR-04.evidence: Every Instance AI tool call goes through the adapter, which enforces the requesting user's RBAC scopes (instance-ai.adapter.service.ts, 7 userHasScopes checks); tests prove cross-project and missing-scope requests are refused (__tests__/instance-ai.adapter.service.security.test.ts:195-543).
